title: BINI: Asiya
description: BINI live in concert — the Philippines' P-pop queens commanding the stage. Fierce choreography, powerful vocals, and Asiya-era energy.

photos.caption: Six across the stage mid-routine, phone screens glowing in the pit below.
Leaning into the mic, backlit by a single red lamp.
Braids and a canvas headwrap under warm light, arms up mid-eight-count.
A wave to the crowd, pink stage lamps burning out of focus behind.
Mid-choreography in front of the drum riser, one hand caught above the head.
Three of them shoulder to shoulder between numbers, mics down.
The full lineup in formation against a red LED wall, over a sea of raised phones.
Eight across the stage under the Asiya flower motif on the screen behind.
The routine breaking apart across the stage as the LED wall bleeds orange.
A smile caught mid-verse against the blue pixel glow of the screen.
Front and centre in denim, the crowd's light spilling onto the stage.
Arms wide in white under a wall of magenta.
